findings.description: From 00:36 to 00:44, the customer is seated at the counter angled toward the camera with the empty kitchen pass-through window visible directly behind him. Across the cut at 00:45, the waitress is suddenly standing at the pass-through window wiping it while the customer is in the background hunched over the counter facing right.

The customer is seated at the diner counter prior to 00:51, but in the counter shot from 00:51 to 00:59 he has completely vanished from the stools, only to reappear seated in the exact same spot at the next cut at 01:00.

In 01:27-01:34, both the customer and the waitress are seated side-by-side on the stools at the counter. At the cut at 01:35-01:36, the shot of the counter shows all stools completely empty with both characters gone, before cutting at 01:37 to a close-up of hands still interacting at the counter.

In the close-up of the counter at 01:38, the second hand entering from the right to pat the customer's hand over the money is a weathered male-looking hand wearing a long-sleeved blue-and-white striped shirt cuff, whereas the waitress wears a short-sleeved light blue polo shirt with bare forearms throughout the scene.

At 01:46-01:49, the waitress is standing upright by the front window on the booth side of the diner watching the customer get into his truck. Across the immediate cut at 01:50, she is suddenly seated on the customer's stool at the counter leaning over the counter surface.

As the waitress stands up from the stool at 01:51 and walks around the front of the counter to go behind it, a second identical copy of the waitress simultaneously appears behind the counter in the background wiping the surface, leaving two identical waitresses visible together through 01:58.
